description.en: Syria and Lebanon; most of the Golan (except the triangle assigned to Palestine).
description.ar: سوريا ولبنان؛ معظم الجولان (باستثناء المثلث المخصّص لفلسطين).
description.he: סוריה ולבנון; רוב רמת הגולן (מלבד המשולש שהוקצה לפלשתינה).

sources.quote: a triangular area on the Golan, with Quneitra at the head of the triangle, was included within Palestine.
On the west, the frontier will pass from Semakh across the Lake of Tiberias to the mouth of the Wadi Massadyie.

From that point it will reach the track from El Kuneitra to Banias at the point marked Skek, thence it will follow the said track, which will remain in the territory under the French mandate as far as Banias.
sources.note: Under the 1920 convention the line ran from the east shore of the lake up the Wadi Massadiya and Wadi Jeraba to the Quneitra-Banias track, leaving the area west of that line (the western Golan) on the Palestine side.

sources.quote: The boundary on the north was determined by the Franco-British Convention of the 23rd December, 1920, and was delimited in 1922.
Temmuz 1920’de Beyrut-Şam arasında Han Meyselûn’da Fransızlar’ın Suriyeliler’i ağır bir yenilgiye uğratmasının ardından Suriye’de Faysal dönemi sona erdi ve kendisi sürgüne gönderildi.
sources.note: 'In July 1920, after the French heavily defeated the Syrians at Khan Maysalun between Beirut and Damascus, Faisal's period in Syria ended and he was exiled.'

sources.quote: The international boundary between Israel and Lebanon was established pursuant to the 1923 Agreement between France and Great Britain entitled “Boundary Line between Syria and Palestine from the Mediterranean to El Hamme”.

description.en: Syria (incl. the whole Golan) and Lebanon.

sources.quote: left the entirety of the Golan Heights under French control

The international boundary between Israel and Lebanon was established pursuant to the 1923 Agreement between France and Great Britain entitled “Boundary Line between Syria and Palestine from the Mediterranean to El Hamme”.
thence S.S.W. to Jisr Benat Yaqub, thence southwards along the Jordan to Lake Tiberias, thence along the eastern shore of the Lake of Tiberias
sources.note: The delimited line of 1922 (confirmed in 1923) followed the Jordan and the lake shore, leaving the Golan east of it on the French side.

sources.quote: Lebanon achieved full independence on 22 November 1943 and Syria on 1 January 1944.

description.en: Syria (incl. the Golan) until the completion of French and British withdrawal; Lebanon independent from Nov 1943.
description.ar: سوريا (بما فيها الجولان) حتى اكتمال الانسحاب الفرنسي والبريطاني؛ لبنان مستقل منذ تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر 1943.
description.he: סוריה (כולל רמת הגולן) עד להשלמת הנסיגה הצרפתית והבריטית; לבנון עצמאית מנובמבר 1943.

sources.quote: Although independence had been proclaimed on November 22, 1943

sources.locator: section 'National Governments and the Legacy of Colonial Welfare, 1944-46' (opening)
sources.quote: Allied pressure forced the French not only to reinstate the Lebanese government but also to relinquish their civilian powers in both countries.

sources.locator: section 'National Governments and the Legacy of Colonial Welfare, 1944-46'
sources.quote: On January 1, 1944, the French transferred to the national governments the main pillar of their rule: the Common Interests administration.

sources.locator: section 'National Governments and the Legacy of Colonial Welfare, 1944-46'
sources.quote: By the end of 1944, the only important institutions still left in French hands were their own army, the Troupes spéciales (the locally recruited military), and the Serail building

sources.locator: section 'National Governments and the Legacy of Colonial Welfare, 1944-46'
sources.quote: Second, the states did not yet face prohibitive military costs, which they would after the French withdrawal in 1946.

notes.en: Syria was formally independent (proclaimed 1941, Quwatli government from 1943) during this slice; the slice records continued French presence.
notes.ar: كانت سوريا مستقلة رسميًا (أُعلنت 1941، حكومة القوتلي منذ 1943) خلال هذه الشريحة؛ وتسجل الشريحة استمرار الوجود الفرنسي.
notes.he: סוריה הייתה עצמאית רשמית (הוכרזה ב-1941, ממשלת קוואתלי מ-1943) במהלך פרוסה זו; הפרוסה מתעדת את המשך הנוכחות הצרפתית.
